html:
The Veps are a small Baltic Finnic people living between Lake Ladoga, Lake Onega and the White Lake in northwest Russia. They are on the map for 800.

They are usually identified with the "Ves" of the Primary Chronicle, one of the peoples, with Slavs and Chuds, said to have invited Rurik to rule them. Beloozero on the White Lake was their main centre. They lived by farming, hunting and fishing, and came under the rule of Novgorod. Their language, close to Finnish and Karelian, is spoken today by only a few thousand people. Their northern neighbours were the Karelians.
sum: The Veps are a small Baltic Finnic people living between Lake Ladoga, Lake Onega and the White Lake in northwest Russia. They are on the map for 800.
